relationships.subject: Corneal epithelial injury
relationships.evidence_quote: In the SBNP, the sum length of TRPV1+ nerves was higher in the central cornea (P < 0.05, Fig. 2N) but not in the peripheral cornea (P > 0.05, Fig. 2N), indicating a higher proportion of TRPV1+ nerves in the basal epithelium after injury.

relationships.subject: Stromal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: The novel expression of TRPV1 by resident corneal stromal macrophages was also reported.

relationships.subject: Dendritic cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Our evidence of epithelial neuroimmune interactions suggests that DCs preferentially associate with TRPV1+ nerves, during both homeostasis and after injury.

key_findings: TRPV1+ nerves are ~40% of epithelial and ~80% of stromal corneal nerve length; their proportion in basal epithelium rises after injury
Intraepithelial DCs preferentially contact TRPV1+ nerves and stromal macrophages express TRPV1 in CD68+ lysosomes
